title: Coconut Oil vs Olive Oil: Why Their Nutrition Is So Different

seo.title: Coconut Oil vs Olive Oil: Key Differences
seo.meta_description: Coconut oil has about 82 g saturated fat per 100 g versus roughly 14 g in olive oil. Calories are similar, but the fatty-acid profiles are very different.
seo.search_intent: Compare coconut and olive oil by saturated fat, calories, and everyday use.

excerpt: Both oils provide about 120 calories per tablespoon, but their fat profiles are very different: coconut oil is about 82% saturated fat by weight, while olive oil is around 14%. Olive oil is therefore much richer in unsaturated fat for everyday use.
content_html:
Two oils can have almost identical calorie counts and still be nutritionally far apart. Coconut oil is predominantly saturated fat; olive oil is predominantly monounsaturated fat.

The 100-gram comparison is stark

Coconut oil provides roughly 82 grams of saturated fat per 100 grams. Olive oil is around 14 grams. At a tablespoon scale, that is roughly 11–12 grams versus about 2 grams of saturated fat.

Calories barely change: both are oils and provide close to 120 calories per tablespoon. Switching to olive oil changes fat quality much more than energy.

Coconut oil can still have a culinary role

Its flavor and semi-solid texture are useful in some curries, baked goods, and specialty recipes. Using it because a recipe benefits from coconut flavor is different from making it the default fat for every meal.

For an everyday cooking fat

Public-health guidance favors replacing some saturated fat with unsaturated fat. On that criterion, olive oil is the stronger everyday default, while coconut oil makes more sense when its particular flavor or texture is the point.

faq.question: Which has more calories?
faq.answer: They are nearly the same, at roughly 120 calories per tablespoon.

faq.question: Why is coconut oil solid?
faq.answer: Its high saturated-fat content makes it solid or semi-solid at temperatures where olive oil remains liquid.

faq.question: Does coconut oil contain cholesterol?
faq.answer: Plant oils contain no cholesterol, but coconut oil is very high in saturated fat, which can raise LDL cholesterol.
